title: Ashleworth Adventure
description:
We shall meet at 8:30 outside Ashleworth Hub.
The run is about 16.5 of trail with a small amount run on lanes. There are some muddy parts, through woods and fields. A little elevation here and there and lots of gates and stiles.
This will be a social run, but you should be able comfortable covering this distance. 
We should take about 3 hours and finish back at the Hub.
I have asked if they would be able to do bacon sandwiches for us ( I will book in advance if large numbers).
If you click in I’ll create a WhatsApp to finalise any dietary requirements etc.
We are planning to car share - leaving Malvern at 8am. 
Any questions Sarah [Phone Number Redacted] (run leader)
